note: The session's shared web-search allowance ran out after six searches for this part, so most findings come from official pages read directly: the Kentucky State Board of Elections' 2022 and 2024 general election recaps (county by county) and the Kentucky Court of Justice's county pages. The 2022 recaps for Allen, Barren, Breckinridge, Carroll, Clinton, Fayette, Gallatin, Grant, Johnson, Lawrence, Magoffin, Mercer, Nelson, Owsley and Union are image scans with no text layer and were not read, so earlier runs there are not recorded. No campaign website was found for anyone in this part. Kimberly Abrams (Louisville Metro Council District 25) is not printed on the county clerk's November ballot in our record (the race lists Khalil "Charlie" Batshon only), and nothing was found for her. Ben Kemplin's 2022 coroner race in Logan County and Jennie Hollon's 2022 and 2024 Danville commission races are close or many-way contests whose county totals are not cleanly printed in the recaps, so no 2022 outcome is recorded for them. Laquita Y. Gaskins, Rachel Bray, Kyle Tipton and Gregory Vincent (as a printed candidate) appear in none of the 2022 or 2024 text recaps read for their counties.
